### Colliers announces new leadership appointments across Mainland China and Hong Kong


11/03/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/432246625/files/doc_news/2026/Nov/03/Colliers-announces-new-leadership-appointments-across-Mainland-China-and-Hong-Kong.pdf)


Leadership structure connects clients to opportunities across Mainland China, Hong Kong and international markets


ASIA PACIFIC, November 4, 2026 – Colliers has appointed Tammy Tang as Chief Executive Officer, Mainland China and Hong Kong and CK Lau as Chairman, Mainland China and Hong Kong effective 1 January 2027.


The appointments reflect Colliers' continued focus on bringing together the strengths of its Mainland China and Hong Kong businesses to better support clients operating across local and international markets.


Tang has led Colliers' Mainland China business for almost a decade, helping clients navigate change, strengthening market presence and driving growth in one of the world's most dynamic real estate markets.


In her expanded role, Tang will provide strategic leadership across Mainland China and Hong Kong, helping clients capitalise on opportunities across the globe.


“Mainland China and Hong Kong are two of the most important markets in the global economy – and our clients are increasingly operating across both,” said John Kenny, Chief Executive Officer, Asia Pacific. “Together, they provide a strategic platform for Colliers to support the evolving needs of our clients.


“Tammy is a proven leader who has played a significant role in the growth and success of our Mainland China business. Her appointment will help us accelerate opportunities for local companies, international clients and global investors.”


Tang said clients today were increasingly looking for advice that extended across markets and borders.


“Hong Kong’s position as a leading international business and financial centre, combined with the scale and opportunity of Mainland China, means we are even better positioned to connect clients with the expertise and insights they need to succeed in across the region,” she said. “I look forward to working with our teams to deliver greater value for clients in both markets and beyond.”


At the same time, CK Lau will transition to the role of Chairman, Mainland China and Hong Kong. During his leadership of Colliers’ Hong Kong business, Lau has played an important role in accelerating success for clients in one of Asia Pacific’s most dynamic markets.


“I am proud of the strong business and client relationships we have built in Hong Kong over many years,” Lau said. “In my new role, I look forward to continuing to contribute to the growth of our business and helping clients navigate opportunities across the region.”


Kenny said: “These appointments position us well for the next phase of growth across Asia Pacific while continuing to create value for our clients, people and business.”

**About Colliers**


Colliers is a global diversified professional services and investment management company operating through three industry-leading businesses: Commercial Real Estate, Engineering, and Investment Management. With greater than a 30-year track record of consistent growth and strong recurring cash flows, we scale complementary, high-value businesses that provide essential services across the full asset lifecycle. Our unique partnership philosophy empowers exceptional leaders, preserves our entrepreneurial culture, and ensures meaningful inside ownership — driving strong alignment and sustained value creation for our shareholders. With $6 billion in annual revenues, 28,000 professionals, and $110 billion in assets under management, Colliers is committed to accelerating the success of our clients, investors, and people worldwide. Learn more at[corporate.colliers.com](https://corporate.colliers.com/en) .
